title: Selling a Houston Condo With a Special Assessment
description: Selling a Houston condo? Separate monthly dues, unpaid assessments and planned projects before comparing offers or estimating your closing proceeds.

faq.q: Are monthly condo dues the same as a special assessment?
faq.a: Keep the regular payment, any unpaid assessment and planned association projects separate. Have the actual notices and association records reviewed rather than assuming they are one charge.

faq.q: Who prepares the TREC condominium resale certificate?
faq.a: TREC describes the certificate as prepared and signed by the condominium association. Ask the closing team which current documents apply to the actual transaction.

faq.q: Does the standard house HOA checklist cover my condo?
faq.a: No. Our non-condominium HOA guide is a different checklist. Confirm the property's legal classification and condominium-specific paperwork.

faq.q: Does selling for cash automatically cancel an assessment?
faq.a: No. The applicable documents and written transaction terms must be reviewed. A purchase proposal does not decide what an association can collect.
